purpose: issue #20 D-AMP tuning at 110 cm, roles swapped (COM6 amp silent after the move): level, frequency, thresholds, silent false-positive controls; recommend only

setup.orientation: boards as placed for COM6->COM10 (speaker faces mic, same height); now COM10 speaker -> COM6 mic, relative orientation not checked
notes: Emitter COM10 (MAC 24:dc:c3:49:b7:38), Analyzer COM6 (MAC 24:dc:c3:4a:b0:50). RAW check: 3200 Hz at ~21k vs ~100 floor at 0.1 FS.
Silent controls: SEQ OBS with the Emitter in REMOTE; any detector accept = false positive.
